# EnterpriseGlue v0.16.1 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.16.0`.

## Highlights

- **plugin-installation-toolchain:** Allows protected plugin-toolchain publication to safely reuse an unchanged immutable Helm chart when only archive timestamps or ownership metadata differ.

## User and administrator impact

- Plugin installation toolchain publication can complete when an existing chart version has the same files, permissions, links, and contents as the release source.
- A real chart payload, permission, link, or path change under an existing immutable version still fails the release closed.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The canonical comparison verifies tar checksums, rejects unsafe or duplicate paths and unsupported entry types, and includes file contents, executable modes, link targets, and security-relevant extended attributes.
- Only archive timestamps and ownership metadata are excluded because they do not change the deployed chart payload.

## Documentation

- The generated release notes explain that immutable chart reuse is based on a fail-closed canonical payload comparison.

## Rollback

- Revert the release workflow change to restore byte-for-byte archive comparison; already published chart artifacts remain immutable.

## Validation evidence

- Canonical chart archive unit tests covering metadata-only changes, file contents, executable modes, added paths, unsafe paths, and malformed tar headers
- Protected plugin-toolchain release policy checks and comparison against the chart artifact from the failed v0.16.0 toolchain run

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `plugin-toolchain-canonical-chart-reuse`
- Audiences: administrators, operators, developers, security
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
